rust_summary:
a client hook for frames (`native_no_render`): dropped items hidden or still, a stack as one item, experience orbs,
falling blocks and firework rockets hidden, and particles by kind (`ParticleHide`) never made.
doc_summary: `native_no_render`: what the world leaves undrawn on this client (dropped items hidden or lying still, a stack drawn as one item, experience orbs, falling blocks, firework rockets) and the particles never made (`ParticleHide`: all, bone meal sparkles, block crumbs, explosions, fireworks). Bundles need "hooks": @API:incari_no_render@.
